bibliographic.title: werewolf roulette
bibliographic.author: Polaris Storm
bibliographic.description:
Have you ever wanted to play as a werewolf? Have you ever wanted to constantly die? This game is for you!

This is an entry to the RETURN OF THE REALLY BAD IF Jam, including such things as:
- 3 main endings with several different variations of them!
- A 10-option choice branch, where 9 are instant deaths!
- Absolutely garbage writing!
- A barely-readable font and colors!
- Softlocking deaths!
- Absolutely no undo button!
- Absolutely no walkthrough!

Have "fun" guys!
